description.value: Pizzability is a 100% Vancouver Island-owned pizza restaurant on West Coast Road in Sooke, making dough in-house daily and small-batch sauces from scratch with premium toppings. The menu spans classic 90s-style pies, Egyptian-inspired Baladi thin-crust options, house specials, pasta, wings, and salads, with both delivery and in-store pickup available. Located at a natural resupply point along the West Coast Road corridor, it offers a solid hot-meal stop for cyclists heading toward the Juan de Fuca Trail area.
